plugins.name: bmad-workflows
plugins.description: BMAD agents + workflows + QA skills + slash commands + BMAD runtime guards (agent scope, output consistency, config priority). Full BMAD layer in one plugin.

plugins.name: test-enforcement
plugins.description: Pre-write quality gates: spec tags, quality checklist (9 rules), fixture/helper prereqs, security reminder, run-then-fixme.

plugins.name: cost-control
plugins.description: Cost optimization: block duplicate Read calls to avoid wasted cache_read tokens. Compact-aware with auto-allow escape valve.

plugins.name: qa-context
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit context injectors: preload skill docs, enforce roadmap reading, orchestrate test automation checklist.

plugins.name: consumer-setup
plugins.description: SessionStart startup check nudging consumers to create required files/folders (BMAD config, roadmap, playwright config, src/, tests/).

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Session lifecycle + logging: start/stop/cleanup/logger-init/logger-tool. Bundles langfuse-helper.js for telemetry.

plugins.name: langfuse
plugins.description: Langfuse telemetry & scoring: score-detector hook + push-score / accuracy-efficiency utilities. Bundles langfuse-helper.js.
